body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Automates radiated and conducted immunity testing per IEC 61000-4. EMC immunity automation drives signal generators, amplifiers, and antennas through IEC 61000-4-3/-4-6 sweeps, monitoring DUT performance criteria A/B/C. Real implementations include Rohde & Schwarz ELEKTRA, AR, and ETS-Lindgren TILE. It calibrates field uniformity, logs every dwell, and generates compliance reports.
